product.olivetti-pcs33.summary: Compact 1992 desktop with a 25 MHz 386SX, for general office use.
product.olivetti-pcs33.history: The PCS 33 came out in November 1992 with the PCS 11 and PCS 44, as the middle model for general office use: 25 MHz 386SX, 2 MB of memory, a 1.44 MB floppy drive and a 40 to 120 MB hard disk, with MS-DOS 5.0 and Windows 3.0 preinstalled. It uses the BA013/25 board, the same technical base as the M300-02F, with its own BIOS (R6.03).
product.olivetti-pcs33.technical.verifie: The R6.03 BIOS (128 KB) is identified and runs on the same BA013/25 emulation as the M300-02F.
product.olivetti-pcs33.technical.limitat: Partial, provisional emulation. No PCS 33 manual confirms the board, and the case is not modelled. Booting with its own BIOS still has to be checked.
